title: The clinic
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Monday. The county clinic. The strip goes to the parking lot and no further. Then a one-week gap, dated.

panels.composition: A county veterinary clinic in winter rain — the same clinic as 1999, the same steel-table building, older. The Legacy. Gully's flatbed beside it. WOOD carrying BARNABY in the blanket toward the door. GULLY holding the door.

image.prompt: a small county veterinary clinic in winter rain, an old Subaru and a flatbed truck parked outside, a man carrying a blanket-wrapped old dog toward the door that a stocky man holds open, desaturated wash, no words
image.notes: The same clinic as dw_1999-11-17. Fifteen years.

panels.composition: The door. Gully's hand on it. Wood and the dog going through. The strip stays outside.

image.prompt: close-up of a stocky man's hand holding a clinic door open as a man carrying a wrapped dog passes through, the viewpoint staying outside, no words

panels.composition: The parking lot. The two vehicles. Rain. The door closed. Nothing.

image.prompt: a rainy clinic parking lot with an old Subaru and a flatbed truck and a closed door, nothing happening, desaturated watercolor, no words

panels.composition: The lot. Later. Gully's flatbed gone. The Legacy alone. The door. Rain. The strip does not go in and does not show anyone come out.

image.prompt: the same rainy clinic parking lot later with only the old Subaru remaining, the door closed, rain, no words
image.notes: The next page in the book is a dated divider: 'November 25 – 29, 2014.' No strips ran. Then 'The Empty Chair.'

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: The clinic. The strip stays in the lot. A one-week gap follows, dated, then 'The Empty Chair.'
